sites.home_text:
Get the app 
SentiaRead

Get the app 
Make English easier to
read and understand 
 Acquire English naturally through stories and articles you love. Novels, news, podcasts: turn what you enjoy into the best learning materials. AI provides exact definitions in context and simplifies tangled sentences so you never get stuck. 
Start reading 
Available on iPhone, iPad, Android, Mac, Windows, E-Ink, and Chrome. 
Everyday English · 2 min read 
A quiet Sunday in the city 
My friend and I wanted coffee before we went to the park. We walked to a small street near the river. 
The café looked nice, but it was very crowded . There were no free tables, so we tried another place. 
The second café was calmer. We sat by the window and read for an hour. 
crowded adj. More › 
 US /ˈkraʊdɪd/ Pronunciation accent US UK 
full of people, with little room to move or sit. 
 Add to vocabulary 
Reading in English shouldn't feel this exhausting 
Stopping every two sentences to look up words, untangle clauses, and guess meanings breaks your momentum until the excitement for the book completely fades. 
Looking up words breaks your focus every single time 
Bilingual dictionaries list blunt translations without context, while standard English dictionaries use complex definitions that are harder than the word itself. By the time you untangle the meaning and jump back, your train of thought is gone. 
You know every word, but the sentence still reads like code 
Convoluted clauses and familiar words with unfamiliar meanings leave you reading the same line four times without getting the point. Pasting it into a translator only spits out clunky, robotic prose that feels even worse. 
Look up, forget, repeat: words never stick 
Words you aced in flashcard apps vanish the moment you see them in real articles. Words you looked up two pages ago feel completely foreign when they appear again. You put in the hours, but nothing seems to stay. 
Hours in your native language, drained in 10 minutes of English 
You can breeze through a native-language novel in one sitting, but two pages of English make your eyes heavy and reach for your phone. Constantly decoding words and parsing syntax silently burns through all your mental energy. 
Remove the friction from reading, piece by piece 
Stop burning mental energy on clumsy lookups, convoluted syntax, and endless guesswork. When comprehension feels effortless, you can finally stay in the flow of great writing. 
A Family Business — Chapter 2 
He copied the address onto the envelope, then stood up to address the room. 
 address verb More › 
 US /əˈdres/ 
 US UK 
to stand up and speak to all the people in the room. 
 Add to vocabulary 
A dictionary gives “address” a long list of senses. This line uses two of them. 
AI definitions tailored to your exact context 
Tap any unfamiliar word to get a clear, level-appropriate English explanation for its precise meaning in this sentence. No digging through a long list of dictionary entries or leaving the page.
If you're ever unsure, explanations in your native language are always one tap away, keeping your reading flow uninterrupted. 
 Explore feature 
Who Read the Report? 
 What made the plan work was less the money than the fact that nobody, least of all the people it was meant to help, had been asked whether they wanted it. 
 AI Analysis 
 Simplified Key Vocabulary Structure

What made the plan work / was less the money / than the fact that nobody, / least of all the people it was meant to help, / had been asked whether they wanted it. 
 For your level · A2 
The plan worked mainly / because nobody was asked whether they wanted it / — not even the people it was supposed to help. The money mattered less than that. 
Meanings 
这项计划之所以成功，主要不是因为资金，而是因为从始至终根本没有人征询过受助群体的意愿。 
Complex sentences and paragraphs, simplified into clear, effortless English 
Stuck on a convoluted sentence or dense paragraph you've re-read three times?
Select it, and AI faithfully rewrites it into plainer, clearer English broken into natural thought groups, keeping every original detail and logic intact. You can also pair it with a natural native-language translation to assist your understanding, so you never have to guess in the dark.

readmes.kevinma2010/hexo-theme-vno:
hexo-vno
========
这个主题是修改自[onevat的vno](https://github.com/onevcat/vno), 它遵从简洁和响应式的设计风格，拥有一个独立的封面，易于集成的 Disqus 评论和多说系统，Google Analytics,字体图标以及多种颜色。
## Demo Show
## 封面
### 图片和颜色
将您的封面图片放到主题的 source/images/ 下，将图片文件改名为background-cover.jpg或修改_config.iml中background的cover字段值即可。您也可以改变封面的颜色。找到_config.iml中background的color字段值,然后替换成您需要的颜色即可。默认为您提供了七种选择：
* `cover-blue` - #2568A3
* `cover-green` - #156F78
* `cover-purple` - #493252
* `cover-red` - #E25440
* `cover-orange` - #FB9C50
* `cover-slate` - #3D4260
* `cover-disabled` - 透明
### 头像和简介
头像可以在封面中显示,将头像文件放到主体的 source/images/下, 修改_config.yml中的logo字段值即可。
您还可以在封面页上写一个简短的介绍, 填写全局的_config.yml(注意:不是主题下的_config.yml)中的description字段值, 支持html标签。
## Installation
### Install
``` bash
$ git clone https://github.com/lenbo-ma/hexo-theme-vno.git themes/vno
```
### Enable
Modify `theme` setting in `_config.yml` to `vno`.
### Update
``` bash
cd themes/vno
git pull
```
## Configuration
```yml
# menu子菜单可随意配置
menu:
#  项目作品: /projects
#  关于我: /aboutme
rss: /atom.xml
# description配置内容会出现在meta标签中，因此会被搜索引擎抓取
# description: blog description
# 不填写的链接则不显示
social:
  github: https://github.com/lenbo-ma
  twitter: https://twitter.com/lenbo_
  weibo: 
  google_plus: 
# 封面中的头像
logo: /images/logo2.jpg
# cover处填写背景图片, color处填写覆盖层的颜色样式名
background:
  cover: /images/background-cover.jpg
  color: cover-blue
archive_date_format: MMM DD
# 多说的帐号名, 不配置则不启用
duoshuo_shortname: 
# google_analytics: 
# 网站的favicon图片
favicon: /favicon.ico
```
如果使用disqus，需要在hexo的全局配置文件中配置, duoshuo_shortname字段留空即可

readmes.kevinma2010/gso:
gso(Google So)
===
这是一个用Node.JS编写的Google搜索服务，原理是拿着用户的关键词去Google服务器搜索，然后将返回的结果响应给用户。
[可用服务列表](https://github.com/lenbo-ma/gso/wiki/%E5%8F%AF%E7%94%A8%E6%9C%8D%E5%8A%A1%E5%88%97%E8%A1%A8)
关于证书的说明：文件列表中提供的证书仅为测试使用，在生产环境下需替换为你自己的证书
----
## 部署
### 安装：
```sh
git clone https://github.com/lenbo-ma/gso.git
cd gso
npm install --production
```
### 运行命令：
#### 测试/调试：
`npm start` 或 `node ./bin/run`
#### 生产环境
* 使用[forever](https://github.com/nodejitsu/forever)启动：  
`forever start -e err.log -o output.log ./bin/run`
* 使用[pm2](https://github.com/Unitech/pm2)启动：  
`pm2 start ./bin/run -i max`
## 自定义设置
### 站点名称
设置站点名称后会在首页logo下，浏览器标题栏中显示。
修改conf/config.js文件, 找到name节点, 修改为自己的站点名：
```javascript
name: '谷搜客'
```
### 统计脚本
将脚本粘贴到views/partials/statistics.ejs文件中
### 首页随机文字
将文字粘贴到data/words.txt中，每句以一个空行分割, 支持html代码
### 设置多个Google IP防止被屏蔽
将可用的IP放入conf/ip.txt文件中,每个ip以一个回车换行分割.
### 设置HTTP代理服务器
有时,我们可能需要设置一个代理服务器,比如google的ip失效暂时无法使用或被google屏蔽的时候.
修改conf/config.js文件, 找到proxy节点:
```javascript
proxy: { 
      enable: false,  //设置是否启用
      timeout: 5000,  //设置超时时间, enable为true时有效
      host: '',  //代理服务器地址
      port: 80  //代理服务器端口
  }
```
### 静态文件压缩
clone后的代码是未压缩的，可以使用grunt工具进行压缩。
#### 压缩js，css文件
1. 安装grunt工具: `npm install -g grunt-cli`
2. 在项目根目录执行`grunt static`命令
3. 修改conf/config.js中的r_prefix值为`/public`
注：执行grunt命令前必须使用`npm install`安装依赖，而不是`npm install --production`
#### html代码压缩
启动服务前设置`NODE_ENV`为`production`即可，如`NODE_ENV=production forever start bin/run`
## 完成记录
1. 增加“相关搜索”功能;
2. OpenSearch, 支持IE，Firefox，Chrome设置为默认搜索引擎;
3. 简单的敏感词检测，否则连接会被墙/连接重置;
4. HTML代码压缩，基于html-minifier模块进行压缩已渲染好的HTML代码;
5. headroom功能(当页面向下滚动时，搜索区消失，当页面向上滚动时，搜索区又出现了。个人觉得这个体验对小屏幕笔记本及pad比较好，尤其是手机终端);
6. 实现HTTPS功能(关键词加密);
7. 使用cheeio替代jQuery解析;
8. 输入框自动完成;
9. 搜索内容语言切换;
10. 根据时间段筛选结果;
11. 使用filetype指令搜索时，结果项前缀显示filetype;
12. 支持设置多个Google IP(2014-12-25);
13. 增加HTTP代理功能(2014-12-28);
14. 优化手机端使用体验(2015-1-13);
15. 支持键盘快捷键(2015-1-13);
## TODO
* [ ] Pad显示优化，字体优化;
* [ ] 支持维基百科检索;
* [ ] 优化错误日志记录;
* [ ] 支持视频元信息检索(同时检索可播放来源)
* [ ] 增加在线代理功能(代理搜索结果中出现的部分被屏蔽的网站)；
